page.overview:
What is Phantom Forest?

Phantom Forest is a location in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius.

While the Phantom Forest has the same name as a location in Final Fantasy VI in English, their Japanese names are different. Instead, Mystic Woods in Olderion has the same name in Japanese.
